Anika: smoke onboarding run for hf://open-oss/smaug-v2 failed on dedicated: KV cache shape mismatch on first generation
Anika: error from runtime: `RuntimeError: KV cache shape mismatch: expected (batch=1, heads=32, seq=8, head_dim=64) got (batch=1, heads=64, seq=8, head_dim=64)`
Anika: stack: serving/runtime/kv_cache.cc:142
Anika: model config attached in conversion artifact: `config.json` has `num_key_value_heads: 64`, `max_position_embeddings: 2048`, no `sliding_window` field, `rope_scaling: null`
Samir: hmm, runtime assumed 32 heads for that model family (we default to half heads for kv layout). Did the HF config say `kv_head_dim` or anything unusual?
Anika: no `kv_head_dim` field, standard `hidden_size: 4096`, `num_attention_heads: 64`. HF->Redwood converter previously inferred kv heads = num_attention_heads / 2 for grouped kv, but this model apparently uses full-keyheads (num_kv_heads == num_attention_heads)
Talia: that matches the mismatch. Also noticed `max_position_embeddings` 2048 vs our default serving bucket 4096. Sliding-window missing means our prefix/cache math assumed longer positions and did implicit truncation patches — could be shifting rope offsets and causing silent generation drift on longer prompts
Liz-QA: confirmed on local reproducer: short prompts 32 tokens ok, but with ~1500 tokens we saw both `kv shape mismatch` and weird token repetition when model ran after we patched heads. Reproduction script:
```
# repro
python serve_repro.py --model ./converted/smaug-v2 \
  --input-file tests/long_prompt.txt --batch 1
```
convert-bot: conversion metadata: `converter_version: 1.8.4`, flags used: `--infer-kv-heads --preserve-max-pos`
Samir: converter flagged `--infer-kv-heads` but inference logic is brittle for some HF configs (e.g. grouped-kv vs per-head). We should add an explicit mapping step: if `num_key_value_heads` present, preserve it, else fallback to heuristic but emit warning
Talia: immediate workaround: patch runtime compatibility layer to accept `num_key_value_heads=64` (resize cache layout) and set `max_position_embeddings` to 2048 in serving config for this model. For sliding windows, explicitly set `sliding_window: 512` to align with training truncation to avoid rope shifts
Anika: tested patch: `service-config.json` changes: `{"max_position_embeddings":2048, "sliding_window":512, "num_key_value_heads":64}` fixed shape error and reduced drift. But we need to validate quality across long-context evals
Liz-QA: ran quantized int8 smoke too — shape fix ok, but quantization degraded long-range coherence slightly (increase in repetition). Suspect rope_scaling defaults differ; HF training used rope scaling factor 0.8, our converter left it null
Samir: propose three actions: 1) converter: preserve explicit `num_key_value_heads` if present and add `--override-rope-scaling` flag; 2) add smoke tests that include long-context (>=1500 tokens) with shape/verifier; 3) create migration lint that errors when `max_position_embeddings` < serving bucket but `sliding_window` absent (dangerous implicit truncation)
Talia: I’ll file the tracker and own the migration lint. @Anika can you paste the minimal failing log and the patched service-config into the ticket?
Anika: done — pasted logs and patch snippets in ticket INF-4217 :bug: :eyes:
Samir: I’ll follow up on converter change, aiming for a patch this week.
Liz-QA: I’ll add the long-context regression to nightly evals and include the quantized int8 baseline.
Talia: thanks, team. Quick note: add a unit to the converter CI that runs `--preserve-max-pos` and `--infer-kv-heads` combos so we don’t regress silently. :white_check_mark:
